WITH per_rating_avg AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_price_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_price_per_day) AS overall_avg_price
  FROM per_rating_avg
),
above_avg_ratings AS (
  SELECT pra.avg_price_per_day,
         oa.overall_avg_price
  FROM per_rating_avg pra
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE pra.avg_price_per_day > oa.overall_avg_price
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_price_per_day) AS avg_per_day_price,
  AVG(avg_price_per_day - overall_avg_price) AS how_far_above_average
FROM above_avg_ratings
